第34章 阴阳通目符-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

下一章

吴姜没有回答老刘的疑问，只是笑着回了一句：“没去哪里，老刘，我今天来，是想再从你这里买些朱砂和黄纸，要质量好点的。”

老刘听到吴姜要的东西，愣了一下。

大半夜的来买朱砂、黄纸，怎么也不像没事的样子。

他的神色变得郑重了许多，看着吴姜，语气严肃地说道：“小伙子，我能感觉到，这个小姑娘身上，还有残留的阴气，这可不是小事。你们赶紧说实话，到底遇到什么事了？免得耽误了，害了这小姑娘。”

吴姜能感受到老刘的善意，而且转念一想，老刘也算半个同行，以后说不定还会有打交道的地方，也就不再隐瞒，简单把遇到小鬼念念的事情，说了一遍。

老刘听完，满脸惊诧，显然没想到，眼前这个看起来年纪不大的年轻人，居然还有这种本事。

吴姜看出了他眼中的怀疑，也不废话，心念一动，就将念念从聚灵吊坠里放了出来。

念念一出来，老刘就瞬间感觉到周围的温度降了下来，一股淡淡的阴气萦绕在身边。

他立刻转身，快步走到柜台前，从抽屉里拿出两枚铜钱，默念几句口诀，将铜钱贴在自己的眼前贴了一下，再睁眼的时候，他清清楚楚地看到，一个五六岁的小丫头，正抱着吴姜的大腿，怯生生的看着他。

直到这时，老刘才彻底相信，吴姜是真的有本事，最起码本事在他之上。

“念念，和伯伯问好。”吴姜摸了一下小萝莉的脑袋，示意她不用害怕。

念念怯生生地抬起头，看了老刘一眼，小声地喊了一句：“伯、伯伯好……”

老刘愣了半天，才反应过来，“哎，好，好！”

天可怜见，他老刘虽然跟着师傅学过一些皮毛，但平时最多也就是给客户除除煞、看看风水，这还是他第一次这么近距离地和鬼交流。

吴姜看着他这副样子，忍不住笑了笑，又摸了摸念念的小脑袋，心念一动，再次将她收进了聚灵吊坠里。

直到念念的身影消失，老刘才长长舒了一口气，看着吴姜，一脸敬佩地说道：“小伙子，好手段！”

吴姜摆了摆手，客气地说道：“没什么，就是刚好碰上了，总不能不管。”

Wu Jiang did not answer Lao Liu's question, but just smiled and replied: "I haven't gone anywhere, Lao Liu. I came here today to buy some more cinnabar and yellow paper from you. The quality should be better."

When Lao Liu heard what Wu Jiang wanted, he was stunned for a moment.

I came here in the middle of the night to buy cinnabar and yellow paper, but it didn't look like anything was wrong.

His expression became much more solemn. He looked at Wu Jiang and said in a serious tone: "Young man, I can feel that this little girl still has residual Yin Qi in her body. This is not a trivial matter. Please tell the truth quickly. What happened? So as not to delay and harm this little girl."

Wu Jiang could sense Lao Liu's kindness, and on second thought, Lao Liu was considered half a colleague, and they might have dealings with him in the future, so he stopped hiding it and simply told the story of his encounter with the little ghost Nian Nian.

After hearing this, Old Liu was full of surprise. He obviously didn't expect that the young man in front of him who looked young could actually have such ability.

Wu Jiang saw the suspicion in his eyes, and without any nonsense, he released Nian Nian from the Spirit Gathering Pendant with a thought.

As soon as the thought came out, Lao Liu instantly felt that the temperature around him had dropped, and a faint yin energy lingered around him.

He immediately turned around, walked quickly to the counter, took out two copper coins from the drawer, recited a few mantras silently, and put the coins in front of his eyes. When he opened his eyes again, he clearly saw a five or six-year-old girl holding Wu Jiang's thigh and looking at him timidly.

Only then did Lao Liu completely believe that Wu Jiang was really capable, at least more capable than him.

"Nian Nian, say hello to uncle." Wu Jiang touched the little Loli's head and told her not to be afraid.

Nian Nian timidly raised her head, glanced at Lao Liu, and whispered: "Uncle, uncle, hello..."

Old Liu was stunned for a long time before he reacted, "Hey, okay, okay!"

Unfortunately, although he, Old Liu, had learned some superficial knowledge from his master, he usually only used to remove evil spirits and read Feng Shui for clients. This was the first time that he had communicated with ghosts at such a close distance.

Seeing his appearance, Wu Jiang couldn't help but smile, then touched Nian Nian's little head, and with a thought, he put her into the spirit-gathering pendant again.

It wasn't until Nian Nian's figure disappeared that Lao Liu breathed a long sigh of relief, looked at Wu Jiang, and said with admiration: "Young man, what a trick!"

Wu Jiang waved his hand and said politely: "It's nothing, it just happened to happen. I can't ignore it."
